tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the vetted non-toxic product catalog by product name, description, or brand. Every result passed the published vetting criteria. Returns up to 10 lean records with page + markdown URLs.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full public record for one product by slug: why it was chosen, certifications, spec sheet, and where to buy (clean merchant links, no trackers). No prices — the product page carries those live.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search published editorial (product guides, news, explainers) by keywords. Each result includes a markdown mirror URL with the full text.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Metadata + product list for one published article by slug. Fetch the markdown_url for the complete body text.

tools.name: list_editorial_sets
tools.description: Curated Sets: hand-picked, ordered lineups of vetted products (4-40 each), composed and human-reviewed — starter kits, room-by-room lineups, budget and life-stage sets. Newest first.

tools.name: get_editorial_set
tools.description: One Curated Set's full ordered lineup with product links. Fetch the markdown_url for the annotated version (per-pick reasons included).

tools.name: get_vetting_criteria
tools.description: The full published criteria every listed product must clear (preconditions, universal exclusions, category rules, certifications weighting) — the standard behind every search_products result.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_editorial_sets" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Curated, ordered sets of vetted products (4-10 each), composed and human-reviewed — starter kits, room-by-room lineups, budget and life-stage sets. Newest first." → after: "Curated Sets: hand-picked, ordered lineups of vetted products (4-40 each), composed and human-reviewed — starter kits, room-by-room lineups, budget and life-stage sets. Newest first."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
